title: Bare Bones x More Chests Variants
description: Bare Bones textures for More Chests Variants mod !
body:
![MCV](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/36756320abeef1227e12bf603ccd3692d1182a7c_0.webp)
-----------

This resource pack simplify the textures of [More Chests Variants](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-chest-variants-lieonlion) to fit with [Bare Bones](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones) resource pack !

⚙️ You have to place it above Bare Bones in the resource pack list

- This resource pack is contained in [Bare Bones x Mods](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones-x-mods) ! It's a more convenient way to use my Bare Bones compatibility packs
